services.name: Love Balloons?
services.desc: Unlike most racing sports, hot air balloon competitions are not about speed. In fact, balloons cannot be steered in the conventional sense. Pilots have no rudder or engine to direct them horizontally; instead, they rely on wind currents at different altitudes. By ascending or descending, they “choose” wind directions,

includes: Participation in setup and teardown of balloon
blurb: Guests join an approximately hour-long hot air balloon flight just outside Portland, Oregon. They ascend slowly over the Willamette Valley, viewing wine country, mountain peaks, volcanoes, and the river below. The company has been flying in the region since 1989 and operates up to six balloons on a given day.
